description:
DU Meter is an Internet usage monitor for Windows that shows your download speed and how much data each app uses.

DU Meter shows what your PC is doing online: how fast you're downloading right now, and how much data each app has used. When your usage suddenly jumps, you can see which app did it.

If your plan has a data cap, DU Meter warns you before you reach it, and it can cut off the network or shut down the computer when you get there.

You can also ask Claude or another AI assistant about your usage, like which app is eating your data and how to make it stop. The assistant only sees DU Meter's statistics, never your traffic, and nothing is shared until you turn this on.

The same small, independent company has made DU Meter since 1997, and people in over 200 countries pay for it. Try it free for 30 days with every feature, and if you keep it, you pay once.
